calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period IN (9,10) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS click_collect_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS control_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS gross_before_returns, SUM(r.returns_net) AS returns_net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'delivered_no_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'fulfil_null_or_other', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE fulfilment_type IS NULL OR fulfilment_type NOT IN ('home_delivery','click_and_collect')
UNION ALL SELECT 'processing_orders_in_window', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='processing' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_nonweb_store', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'store900_lines_no_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_orders_cc_no_pickup', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' AND pickup_store_key IS NULL

SELECT d.fiscal_period, s.store_id = 900 AS booked_to_web, o.fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
